meta.name: create
meta.description: Interactive outline co-creation for developer advocacy content — collects format, audience profile, story arc (Problem→Journey→Insight→Action), and voice/tone; detects out-of-scope requests (FAQs, comparison tables); surfaces conflicts between user brief and audience needs. Writes approved outline to .plans/content/<slug>-outline.md for foundry:creator to execute. Use when starting a blog post, Marp slide deck, social thread, talk abstract, or lightning talk.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。
